headline: Pfizer (PFE) Wins EU Approval For Updated COVID Vaccine Ahead Of 2026 Season
summary: European Commission grants marketing authorization for Pfizer and BioNTech’s XFG-adapted COVID-19 vaccine for the 2026-2027 season in the EU. Approval covers use in individuals aged 6 months and older across all EU member states. Authorization supports advance manufacturing and supply ahead of the upcoming respiratory disease season.
